modules.goal: build a KV-cache ring buffer for autoregressive transformer decoding
modules.rationale: Pre-allocating key and value tensors along the sequence axis avoids repeated memory allocations during token-by-token generation:
modules.code:
import torch

class KVCacheBuffer:
    def __init__(self, max_batch: int, n_heads: int, max_seq: int, head_dim: int, device: str = 'cpu'):
        self.k = torch.zeros(max_batch, n_heads, max_seq, head_dim, device=device)
        self.v = torch.zeros(max_batch, n_heads, max_seq, head_dim, device=device)
        self.pos = 0

    def update(self, new_k: torch.Tensor, new_v: torch.Tensor):
        b, h, t, d = new_k.size()
        self.k[:b, :, self.pos : self.pos + t, :] = new_k
        self.v[:b, :, self.pos : self.pos + t, :] = new_v
        self.pos += t
        return self.k[:b, :, :self.pos, :], self.v[:b, :, :self.pos, :]
